links.outcome: Erasure or alteration of correct table values when reviewing under partial evidence (excerpt missing proof sections)
links.effect: Without the proof in the excerpt, some models erased cells: GPT-6.1 Sol and Sol Pro erased 27 of 36 cells in each twin and changed 5.0 non-target cells per response. Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon kept and flagged almost everything.
links.quote: Without the proof in the excerpt, the models diverged: Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon kept almost everything and flagged it; GPT-6.1 Sol and Sol Pro erased 27 of 36 cells in each twin and changed on average 5.0 non-target cells per response.

unlisted_practices: Adding an explicit keep-rule instruction to LLM reviewer prompts to prevent erasure of unverifiable correct values (erasure fell to zero in 10 of 13 models)
Raising LLM reasoning effort to reduce erasure (cost 1.1 to 21.5 times more tokens and reduced erasure in only three models)
Instructing LLM reviewers to flag rather than erase values they cannot verify

screen.reason: Evaluates the effect of prompt-based safeguards ('keep rule' instructions) on preventing LLMs from improperly erasing unverified clinical data when reviewing extracted genomic reports.
